name: Before you buy checklist

sections.hero: Dek: what to check before buying anything in this category.
sections.items: Each item is a question to ask a seller; the body teaches why it matters, and the product's answer carries a claim_id.
sections.faq: Questions the checklist did not cover.
sections.closing: Recap the three checks that matter most.

items.heading_hint: What the core specification actually includes
Which features are included and which cost extra
What power and installation it needs
What the warranty covers, part by part
How it ships and what happens if it arrives damaged

voice: Helpful advisor, second person, short sentences.
compliance: Every number, price, spec or outcome needs a verified claim_id; a hint is never a fact.
No health or outcome promise for the product; a health statement cites the study and its population.
Never invent an industry standard or a pass mark.
writer_brief: A checklist, not a brochure. Each question teaches; the product's answer is verified facts only.
